content:
BUILT CoLAB has signed a collaboration protocol with the Environmental Fund and APA – Portuguese Environment Agency for the implementation of the “Soil Quality Assessment” project, under Order no. 8485/2023.

The aim of this project is to promote knowledge about contaminated soils in order to train and raise awareness among private sector companies and public authorities in the environmental field about soil quality assessment processes, risk analysis and sustainable soil remediation.

To this end, BUILT CoLAB will organize and promote various digital training and awareness-raising actions, as well as producing support and technical support material in digital format, which will serve to support the continuity of the initiative, making a broad contribution to preventing and combating soil pollution.

The events will take place in the first half of 2024 and will be open to all interested parties, but subject to prior registration. Further information will be released in the coming weeks.
